summary: Utterances taken from the end-to-end golden suites the OVOS skills ship themselves, so the phrasings come from what skill authors expect users to say. One row is one utterance labelled with the skill and intent that should handle it: 2,380 rows across 21 languages, of which 1,007 are English. The non-English slices are small and indicative rather than conclusive. No slot annotation exists, so slot scores are not reported.
notes: Test split of OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents at tag v6.1, the canonical OVOS intent corpus that supersedes the retired OpenVoiceOS/ovos-golden-utterances-bench. Labels are '<skill_id>:<intent_name>'. 2,380 gold rows over 21 locales (en-US 1,007). No train_datasets link: this eval set has no registered template or keyword training corpus, so it is scoped to the open 'intent' (fusion) league only. scripts/build_golden_utterances.py regenerates the retired bench layout, not this one.
